# Avicon Travel

> Avicon Travel is an Egyptian tour operator offering private Egypt tour packages, Nile cruises between Luxor and Aswan, day tours and airport transfers. Prices are per person in US dollars. Book or ask by WhatsApp +20 120 055 5600 or email info@avicontravel.com.

## Day tours
All: https://avicontravel.com/tours/

- [Saqqara, Memphis & Dahshur Day Trip from Cairo](https://avicontravel.com/tours/saqqara-memphis-dahshur-day-trip-from-cairo/): 6 to 8 hours · from $99 per person. Explore ancient Memphis, the Step Pyramid of Saqqara, and Dahshur's famous pyramids on a private Cairo day tour.
- [Abu Simbel Temples Private Tour](https://avicontravel.com/tours/abu-simbel-temples-private-tour/): 8 To 10 Hours · from $100 per person. Visit the monumental temples of Ramses II and Queen Nefertari on a focused Abu Simbel private day trip.
- [Grand Egyptian Museum & Pyramids Tour In Cairo](https://avicontravel.com/tours/grand-egyptian-museum-pyramids-tour/): 6 To 8 Hours · from $90 per person. Combine the Grand Egyptian Museum with the Giza Pyramids in one efficient Cairo sightseeing day tour.
- [Luxor Day Trip From Hurghada Private Tour](https://avicontravel.com/tours/luxor-day-trip-from-hurghada/): 14 To 16 Hours · from $110 per person. Travel from Hurghada to Luxor for a full-day private tour of temples, tombs, and ancient Thebes highlights.
- [Orange Bay Island Snorkeling](https://avicontravel.com/tours/orange-bay-island-snorkeling/): 7 To 9 Hours · from $60 per person. Spend a Red Sea day around Orange Bay with swimming, snorkeling, boat time, and island relaxation.
- [Ras Mohammed Snorkeling](https://avicontravel.com/tours/ras-mohammed-snorkeling/): 7 To 9 Hours · from $65 per person. Explore Ras Mohammed reefs on a snorkeling day trip with clear water, coral gardens, and Red Sea scenery.
- [Giza Pyramids & Saqqara Tour](https://avicontravel.com/tours/giza-pyramids-saqqara-tour/): 6 To 8 Hours · from $50 per person. See the Giza Pyramids and Saqqara in one compact Cairo day tour focused on ancient Egyptian history.
- [Luxor Hot Air Balloon](https://avicontravel.com/tours/luxor-hot-air-balloon/): 2.5 To 4 Hours · from $95 per person. Float above Luxor's West Bank at sunrise for panoramic views of temples, fields, and the Nile landscape.
- [Luxury Cairo Dinner Nile Cruise With Entertainment Show](https://avicontravel.com/tours/cairo-dinner-nile-cruise/): 3 To 4 Hours · price on request. Enjoy an evening Cairo dinner cruise on the Nile with live entertainment, city views, and relaxed dining.
